title: Dustin Howes on Q4 prep, affiliate webinars and his recruitment masterclass
summary: A Real Talk Friday episode of Affiliate Nerd Out where Dustin and co-host Christen Evans chat about finalizing Q4 plans, affiliate leaderboards, and a webinar that doubled in length. Mostly casual banter; the durable business insight is thin, centered on Q4 prep, gamification trade-offs, and building content from interviews with affiliate managers.

principles.text: Lock in your Q4 plans early; don't wait until the season is upon you.
principles.quote: If you are not finalizing your Q4 plans, this is your reminder to do it now.

principles.text: Short-runway, interactive webinars can outperform expectations and generate demand for more content.
principles.quote: It was supposed to be 30 minutes turned into 60 because I had nearly 100 people comment.

principles.text: Build educational content from real interviews with practitioners, capturing what is working right now.
principles.quote: I've been interviewing hundreds of affiliate managers through the years and I've been taking notes and I've been collecting what the good things are and the things that are working right now in the industry.

principles.text: Public affiliate leaderboards cut both ways: gamification motivates, but repeat winners can discourage others.
principles.quote: I think gamification is great in some areas, but when you just see the same people win over and over again like that.
